titulo: การใชปญญาประดษฐในกระบวนการเรยนรายวชาการเขยนบทภาพยนตรและการเลาเรอง
justificativa: This is a pedagogical framework article about teaching screenwriting with AI tools, not an empirical study analysing generated narrative structures.

titulo: ViStoryBench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for Story Visualization
justificativa: This is a story-visualization image benchmark; LLMs only help produce scripts, and the evaluation is about visual consistency, not narrative structure.

titulo: FairyGen: Storied Cartoon Video from a Single Child-Drawn Character
justificativa: This is a video-generation system in which the MLLM storyboard is incidental; the evaluation covers visual style and motion, not narrative structure or diversity.

titulo: Leveraging Natural Language Processing for the Computational Generation of Creative Writing
justificativa: This is a broad review and general evaluation of NLP creative writing (including poetry) that does not specifically analyse the structure, convergence or event graphs of LLM-generated stories.

titulo: Roolipelitehtävien kuvausten generointi GPT-2-kielimallilla
justificativa: This is an Aalto thesis with a Finnish title, so the full text is probably in Finnish; it is also not peer-reviewed, and it only rates whether GPT-2 quest descriptions are acceptable, with no analysis of narrative structure or diversity.

titulo: LLM4DESIGN: An Automated Multi-Modal System for Architectural and Environmental Design
justificativa: The 'narrative storytelling' here refers to design proposal presentation text, not story generation whose structure/plot is analysed.

titulo: ІНТЕГРАЦІЯ ШТУЧНОГО ІНТЕЛЕКТУ В ПРОЦЕС ФОРМУВАННЯ БРЕНД-ОБРАЗІВ ТА ПЕРСОНАЛІЗОВАНИХ КРЕАТИВНИХ РІШЕНЬ У ЦИФРОВОМУ МАРКЕТИНГУ
justificativa: Concerns AI-driven brand image and marketing personalization, not storytelling or narrative structure analysis.

titulo: An experimental creative writing course: rewriting classical myths with ChatGPT
justificativa: This is a teaching report on a creative-writing course; it only mentions in passing that ChatGPT homogenises myths and does not systematically analyse narrative structure, diversity or convergence.

uid: t:ai and literature the impact of artificial intelligence on creative writing and narrative forms
titulo: AI and Literature: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Creative Writing and Narrative Forms
justificativa: This is a broad, essay-like mixed-methods study of AI's impact on literature; it does not clearly describe language-model story generation or any structural, plot or graph analysis of the generated narratives.

titulo: Parallel Memetic-Computational Loops: A Thurmondian Analysis of Valence in Biological and Silicon Substrates
justificativa: A speculative consciousness/valence theory paper unrelated to narrative generation or story structure.

uid: t:digital humanities and artificial intelligence in contemporary english literary studies methodologies epistemologies and emerging research paradigms
titulo: DIGITAL HUMANITIES AND ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE IN CONTEMPORARY ENGLISH LITERARY STUDIES: METHODOLOGIES, EPISTEMOLOGIES, AND EMERGING RESEARCH PARADIGMS
justificativa: Broad review of digital humanities epistemology mentioning AI narrative generation only incidentally, without analysing structure, diversity or convergence of generated stories.

titulo: Accelerating Data Insights with Generative AI for Emissions Reporting in Urban Systems
justificativa: Generative AI is used for regulatory emissions reporting text, not storytelling or narrative structure analysis.

titulo: CutClaw: Agentic Hours-Long Video Editing via Music Synchronization
justificativa: This is a multi-agent video-editing system where storytelling is incidental; it does not analyse narrative structure or diversity, and there is no shared story world.

titulo: Research on the Application of Generative AI in Immersive Tasks for RPG Games
justificativa: This is a literature review of generative AI in RPGs, not a primary empirical study, system or method.

titulo: Title Pending 7436
justificativa: This is a call for papers/special section proposal, not a research contribution.

titulo: Re: Verse - Can Your VLM Read a Manga?
justificativa: This study mainly evaluates how well vision-language models understand and reason about existing manga, not how they generate narratives.

titulo: Wargaming's Methodology, Not Magic
justificativa: A podcast episode summary discussing wargaming methodology, not a peer-reviewed research contribution on LLM-generated narratives.

titulo: Code-Mediated Data Fabrication by Google Gemini: A 127-Turn Case Report with File-System Forensics
justificativa: A case report on data fabrication by an LLM; 'storytelling' only refers to a translated document title, unrelated to narrative generation study.

titulo: Event-centric understanding of multimodal narratives
justificativa: Focuses on event-centric dataset and benchmarks for understanding existing multimodal narratives, not on language models generating narrative content.

titulo: Editorial: Artificial intelligence in animal behaviour, veterinary behaviour and neurology
justificativa: Editorial on AI in veterinary/animal behaviour research, unrelated to narrative generation.

titulo: Works of November 24, 2025 — ψOrigin (Ryan MacLean) PATTERN OF FATHERHOOD - A Structural, Linguistic, and Ritual Analysis of ψOrigin (Ryan MacLean) in Relation to the Biblical "Father" Archetype
justificativa: Self-published theological/speculative work collection, not a research study on LLM-generated narrative structure.

titulo: Editorial
justificativa: An editorial introducing a journal issue, not a research contribution on narrative generation.

titulo: Why AI Models Write Boring Stories
justificativa: Promotional podcast/show-notes style content about a commercial model, not a research contribution with empirical methodology.

titulo: Comparative Qualitative Analysis of AI-Generated Student Videos: AI Tool vs Human Evaluation
justificativa: Focuses on evaluating AI-generated educational videos quality (AI vs human assessment), not on narrative structure, diversity or plot analysis of LM-generated stories.

titulo: Historians: from manuscript to machine learning
justificativa: About historiography and machine learning tools for historians, not about language models generating or analysing narrative/story structure.

titulo: Female Sexual Health and Digitalization: Ethical and Clinical Implications
justificativa: Concerns female sexual health and digital ethics, unrelated to narrative generation by language models.

titulo: Forum on Artificial Intelligence
justificativa: A forum of short opinion essays on AI in screenwriting/film education, not an empirical research study or system.

titulo: Beyond Direct Generation: A Decomposed Approach to Well-Crafted Screenwriting with LLMs
justificativa: This is an LLM screenplay-generation framework evaluated only by preference win rates; it does not explicitly analyse plot structure, diversity, convergence or event graphs.

titulo: PAYADOR: A Minimalist Approach to Grounding Language Models on Structured Data for Interactive Storytelling and Role-playing Games
justificativa: This system grounds an LLM in a world state to predict the outcomes of player actions in interactive storytelling; it does not analyse narrative structure, diversity or convergence, involve multiple interacting characters, or model events as graphs.

titulo: MM-StoryAgent: Immersive Narrated Storybook Video Generation with a Multi-Agent Paradigm across Text, Image and Audio
justificativa: The multiple agents here are production-pipeline tools, not characters in a story world, and evaluation covers only story quality and cross-modal alignment, not narrative structure or diversity.

titulo: Beyond One World: Benchmarking Super Heros in Role-Playing Across Multiversal Contexts
justificativa: The role-play benchmark scores canonical factual recall and moral reasoning alignment, not the structure, diversity or plot of generated narratives, and it has no multi-agent story world.

titulo: DixitWorld: Evaluating Multimodal Abductive Reasoning in Vision-Language Models with Multi-Agent Dixit Gameplay
justificativa: Focuses on multimodal abductive reasoning benchmark via a game; narrative/story generation is incidental to the reasoning evaluation, with no analysis of story structure or diversity.

titulo: Psychologically Enhanced AI Agents
justificativa: Narrative generation is just one of several tasks tested for personality-conditioned agents; no analysis of narrative structure, diversity or convergence.

titulo: Fabula: Building a Narrative Storytelling Sidekick with the Writers' Community
justificativa: An LLM-based system generates stories from hierarchical narratological plans (scenes and beats), and the study evaluates plan-level structure and convergent iteration with writers.

titulo: Long Story Generation via Knowledge Graph and Literary Theory
justificativa: A multi-agent LLM story generator uses a knowledge graph and narratology-based plot framework to address theme drift and plot coherence.

titulo: Knowledge Explorer: An Agentic AI Framework for Interactive, Personalized and Multilingual Learning Experience
justificativa: Storytelling is used only as one pedagogical delivery mode in an educational agent system, without analysis of narrative structure or diversity.

titulo: EduQuick: A Dataset Toward Evaluating Summarization of Informal Educational Content for Social Media
justificativa: LLMs are used for summarization of educational content, not narrative generation.

titulo: GENOME: A Multi-Agent NeuroSymbolic Simulation Framework for Coherent, Memory-Evolved Long-Form Story Generation
justificativa: LLM agents interact in a simulated story world, with symbolic knowledge-graph memory of events, and the study evaluates the global coherence of the generated long-form stories.

titulo: PuppetLine: An Interactive System for Embodied Storytelling with LLM-driven Swarm Robots
justificativa: The LLM translates user-written stories into robot action sequences and does not generate narrative or analyse narrative structure.

titulo: CapSmith: Contextual Refinement of Additive Text Captions for Video Storytelling
justificativa: System refines pre-existing video captions rather than generating or analysing narrative structure, diversity or plot of LM-generated stories.

titulo: Evaluating Narrative Coherence in Collaborative Storytelling with Generative AI
justificativa: Although it targets branching-plot coherence, the abstract says humans write the episodes and the LLM only translates them into symbolic planning representations, so it does not clearly generate narrative.

titulo: Agentic Narrative Generation: Personalised Storytelling for Brand Communication
justificativa: The narratives are brand and marketing messages designed for persuasion and engagement, not storytelling in the review's sense.

titulo: DataNarrative: Automated Data-Driven Storytelling with Visualizations and Texts
justificativa: Data-driven storytelling explains chart insights rather than producing fictional or plot-based narrative, so it is outside the review's sense of narrative.
